Read existing private clonedA/B fixture only; normal UI/API Auth sessions for actions; privileged SQL confined to synthetic fixture setup,independent oracle and narrowly scoped fault.

Cron/import/shared/fault tests exclusively scratch. Use isolated process clock where literal date requires; no OS clock change.
No real Telegram bot delivery/no secrets; local doubles declared. HTTP401 alone does not establish no DB-call order.
Browser assertions blocked until isolated Arc mechanism is verified; no silent Chrome or embeddedArcCore substitution.
